name: sentry-mcp
description: Search, read and triage the issues of a self-hosted Sentry, directly over its API.
long_description: Runs on your computer and talks straight to your own Sentry server, with no relay service and no second LLM in between. Issue search in Sentry's own syntax, full events with the crash point and your code's source lines first, tag breakdowns, Discover counts, releases, and triage: resolve, archive, assign, prioritise and comment. A read-only switch leaves the write tools out.

url.title: Sentry address
url.description: The address you open Sentry at, e.g. https://sentry.company.com

token.title: Auth token
token.description: A User Auth Token (User settings → Personal Tokens) with org:read, project:read, team:read, member:read, event:read and event:write.

org.title: Organization slug (optional)
org.description: Only needed when your account belongs to several organizations.

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Leaves out the tools that resolve, archive, assign and comment on issues.

tools.name: sentry_info
tools.description: Connection check: token owner, scopes, organizations

tools.name: search_issues
tools.description: Find issues with Sentry search syntax

tools.name: get_issue
tools.description: One issue in full, with an event and its stack trace

tools.name: get_issue_tag_values
tools.description: How an issue splits over a tag

tools.name: list_releases
tools.description: Releases with new issues and deploys

tools.name: update_issues
tools.description: Resolve, archive, reopen, assign, prioritise (unless read-only)
